name: Qahngol
body:
The qahngol are a solemn, resilient people whose ancestors forged deep bonds with ancestral spirits and the dead along the great Ghostwall. Characterized by their spiritual tattoos and ceremonial soul masks, they walk the boundary between the mortal realm and the unseen world.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Qahngol are iron-willed and physically sturdy, but their eerie demeanor can make others uneasy. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Humanoid (human). Qahngol are humanoids with the human subtype.
Size: Medium. Qahngol have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Qahngol have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Qahngol begin play speaking Common. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, and Spirit Tongue.
Defense Racial Traits
Ghost Warden: Qahngol gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects, energy drain, negative energy, and spells or spell-like abilities cast by undead or incorporeal creatures.
Soul Mask (Su): Each qahngol crafts a ceremonial soul mask upon coming of age. While wearing this mask, the qahngol gains a +1 deflection bonus to Armor Class against attacks made by incorporeal creatures and a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear and mind-affecting effects. If lost or destroyed, a new mask can be carved and attuned with 24 hours of solitary meditation.
Senses and Magical Racial Traits
Spirit Sight (Sp): Once per day, a qahngol can see ethereal and incorporeal creatures as if under the effect of see invisibility for 1 minute per character level.
Tainted Resilience: Qahngol receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against curses, hexes, and spellblights.
Skill Racial Traits
Spiritual Lore: Qahngol gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (religion) and Knowledge (planes) checks.
